summary: Package main entry fetches and executes remote code from a mutable Bitbucket branch
details: index.js, declared as the package main, is a top-level async IIFE that on module load fetches https://bitbucket.org/p2p-alt-public/p2p-emis/raw/main/GameWebSight, parses the response as HTML, replaces the current document's head and body with the fetched content, and re-creates <script> elements so their JavaScript executes in the consuming page. The source is an unpinned mutable branch on a third-party repository, so whoever controls that repo can push arbitrary JavaScript that will run in every application that loads this package. There is no integrity check, no pinning, and no purpose disclosed that would require this remote-load pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
